The iOS Beta tester program allows you to test the stability of new >x< production builds. Before downloading the Beta app, you’ll need to accept terms (via Apple's TestFlight app). All testers who arrive via the link are anonymous, as far as the Beta program is concerned. Once you download the Beta app, you'll log in to the app just like the production app. No new data will be collected about participants –– Beta testers are treated no differently than anyone one else on >x<. You’ll simply have access to a release a week early. As part of the Beta program, there are a few ground rules to lay out about the program that you've already agreed to. Here are some of the things you can expect to see:
By participating in this program, you’ll get access to early versions of the >x< iOS Beta application on mobile devices that may or may not have bugs or defects.
We may show you confidential, yet to be released products or features and you must be willing to keep those secret.
You'll be volunteering to help out >x< and will not be paid.
You can stop participating in the program at any time and >x< may stop operating the program or cancel your participation in the program at any time.
